Q1 (a) What is the significance of Plank’s quantum theory in quantum mechanics? [2]
 (b) An electron and a proton have the same amount of kinetic energy. Which of the two
possesses greater wavelength?
[3]

[2]

[3]

can be drawn from comparison of the two results?
[3]
